teleology: Capture the current narrative and event tape at T-n as contextual input, not as primary causal truth.
mechanism: Runs tools.news.news to aggregate configured sources into a normalized item list containing text, time, URL, source identity, and optional category tags.
expectation: Return a NEWS artifact as an items array ordered for recency inspection, with text, time, url, source_handle, source_label, and category fields. Missing metadata should be explicit, not silently dropped.
